Sanitätshaus Aktuell AG
is a corporate network and purchasing cooperative (verbundgruppe) for over 480 independent medical retail partners in Germany and internationally. Rather than operating as a single direct-to-consumer brand manufacturer, it centrally organizes purchasing, contracts, and marketing across top-tier medical, orthopedic, and rehabilitation manufacturers.
Sanitätshaus Lappe
Role as a Purchasing Cooperative
Centralized Procurement:
The
Sanitätshaus Aktuell AG
bundles the purchasing volume of its member stores to secure framework agreements with leading medical technology and health-aid manufacturers.
OTWorld
Exclusive and Private Labels:
The group manages proprietary and exclusive lines, such as its "EinfachGut" product range (including care boxes), designed to give member businesses unified, quality-controlled products for insurance-covered prescriptions.
Sanitätshaus Aktuell AG
Partner Network Integration:
Individual member operations coordinate supply chains spanning standard mobility gear, rehabilitation tech, orthopedics, and homecare supplies.
OTWorld
Standard Industry Brands Distributed via Member Stores
Because member storefronts choose individual inventories negotiated through group supplier bonuses and framework terms, they typically distribute industry-leading medical and rehab manufacturers, including:
Mobility & Rehabilitation:
Invacare, Otto Bock, Sunrise Medical, Meyra, and Bischoff & Bischoff.
Orthopedics & Compression:
Bauerfeind, Bort, and BSN medical.
